import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/resources?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")
